biography.value:
Tzeentch Sorcerer. A caster presence from the Warriors of Chaos - Tzeentch, built for brutal, legible table play. Its numbers are recalibrated from a PF2e-style creature benchmark and mapped back onto D&D challenge expectations.

Rules Profile. AC 16; HP 126; proficiency +4; save DC 17. Linked armory entries: 16. Linked spell entries: 5.

"A warrior is measured when the line begins to break."
- Old World battlefield saying

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
